content.comment_body: Hello, I am new to [company_name] [product_name]. I want to enable users to scale analog input using parameters on the HMI in the field. Specifically, users should be able to input minimum and maximum water level values on the HMI after choosing the transmitter range. Is it possible to connect the minimum and maximum values of the analog amplifier block to the HMI for user input? Thank you, [user_name]

You can send the 'Gain' and 'Offset' parameters, as well as the resulting 'Ax amplified' output value, to the HMI using parameter mapping. The 'Gain' and 'Offset' values can be modified using the HMI interface; however, it's not possible to change the sensor type or directly edit the minimum or maximum values of the measurement range from the HMI.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion focuses on the limitation that minimum and maximum values of the analog amplifier block cannot be directly changed via the HMI. Only the 'Gain' and 'Offset' parameters are adjustable through the HMI, which restricts the ability to modify sensor configuration or measuring ranges in the field.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants field personnel to be able to set or adjust minimum and maximum analog measurement values for water level transmitters directly using the HMI.
